Page whose llms.txt exists but has no structure

What is this fixture? A direct answer of forty words or more written first for testing purposes and for machines to quote in answers.

  • First point
  • Second point

This page belongs to a site whose llms.txt file exists but has no structure, so language models get a block of running text with no headings or links to follow. A useful llms.txt file starts with the site name as a heading, adds a short summary of what the site offers, and then lists the most important pages as links with a few words about each one. Keeping it short, accurate and current matters more than trying to cover every page on the site. Treat it like a table of contents written for machines, and refresh it whenever you add or retire a key page.
